p.i: sorum excrementorum aceruus. Nam si par tes quædam sint præcalidæ, aliæ fumosa fuli gine præfocentur, ad cōtrarios profilient mo tus, vt aliæ distensionem moliantur, aliæ con tractionem: sitque pugna hæc tribus modis:
Cùm distensionem incompletam excipiat cō tractio.
Cū prorsus completæ succedat, externa quie te perdita.
Cùm nondum absolutam motus contrarius retrahat, qui debilior redditus, reliquum si nat compleri.
Non firmam esse, non continuò tamen infir mam.
Mediocriter firmam: & præsertim cùm su dorem decretorium promittit.

page.notes: The line "Morbos humidos, pituitosos" ends with a mark that may be a contraction; read as printed. The final "&" stands at the right margin of the last line and is transcribed as printed. Long s throughout is rendered as plain s in the modern-style spelling of the printed text.
